requirement: This code should implement a mode control logic within a function block named FB_ModeController, which handles switching between automatic and manual modes based on Boolean input commands. The function block should have two input variables, bSetToAuto and bSetToManual, both of type BOOL, indicating the command to switch to automatic or manual mode, respectively. It should also have two output variables, eCurrentMode of type MODES, representing the current operational mode, and bModeChanged of type BOOL, indicating whether the mode has changed since the last check. The logic should use a CASE statement on eCurrentMode to switch modes: if eCurrentMode is MODES.AUTO and bSetToManual is TRUE, then set eCurrentMode to MODES.MANUAL; if eCurrentMode is MODES.MANUAL and bSetToAuto is TRUE, then set eCurrentMode to MODES.AUTO. The function block should also track and update the last mode in a local variable eLastMode of type MODES, and set bModeChanged to TRUE if the current mode differs from the last mode.
provide_code:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_ModeController
VAR_INPUT
	bSetToAuto		:	BOOL;	// 切换到自动模式命令
	bSetToManual	:	BOOL;	// 切换到手动模式命令
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	eCurrentMode	:	MODES;	// 当前模式
	bModeChanged	:	BOOL;	// 模式改变标志
END_VAR
requirement_cn: 这段代码应实现一个名为 FB_ModeController 的功能块中的模式控制逻辑，该逻辑根据布尔输入命令处理自动和手动模式之间的切换。功能块应有两个输入变量，bSetToAuto 和 bSetToManual，类型均为 BOOL，分别表示切换到自动模式或手动模式的命令。还应有两个输出变量，eCurrentMode 类型为 MODES，表示当前操作模式，bModeChanged 类型为 BOOL，表示自上次检查以来模式是否已更改。逻辑应使用 eCurrentMode 上的 CASE 语句来切换模式：如果 eCurrentMode 为 MODES.AUTO 且 bSetToManual 为 TRUE，则将 eCurrentMode 设置为 MODES.MANUAL；如果 eCurrentMode 为 MODES.MANUAL 且 bSetToAuto 为 TRUE，则将 eCurrentMode 设置为 MODES.AUTO。功能块还应跟踪并更新一个名为 eLastMode 的本地变量，类型为 MODES，并在当前模式与上次模式不同时将 bModeChanged 设置为 TRUE。
